long_biography.plain_text:
LVMH became Bernard Arnault's platform for assembling a global luxury group while preserving the identities of its individual houses. He secured control after using his family's construction and property capital to acquire the business containing Christian Dior, which became the cornerstone of his strategy.

As chairman and chief executive, Arnault has coupled acquisitions with long-term investment in creativity, craftsmanship and retail. His interest in art and architecture produced the Fondation Louis Vuitton, a private Paris institution commissioned from Frank Gehry. It presents modern and contemporary art in a building conceived as the foundation's first artistic statement.
long_biography.html:
LVMH became Bernard Arnault's platform for assembling a global luxury group while preserving the identities of its individual houses. He secured control after using his family's construction and property capital to acquire the business containing Christian Dior, which became the cornerstone of his strategy.

As chairman and chief executive, Arnault has coupled acquisitions with long-term investment in creativity, craftsmanship and retail. His interest in art and architecture produced the Fondation Louis Vuitton, a private Paris institution commissioned from Frank Gehry. It presents modern and contemporary art in a building conceived as the foundation's first artistic statement.
